referenceRole: reference-only; no mesh, vertices, textures, dimensions, or source geometry are stored

facade.floorRhythm: derive a new floor cadence; do not reproduce source cadence
facade.facadeRhythm: repeating dock-bay rhythm with limited glazing
facade.balconyPattern: not primary; use depth, fins, or service articulation
facade.windowRatio: choose a new solid-to-glass ratio within district policy

architectureGrammar.core: offset or paired core selected independently for the derivative

roof.rule: monitor roof, solar field, and mechanical vents
roof.crown: non-iconic and distinct from reference silhouette

architectureGrammar.sideTreatment: front, side, and rear façades must differ in depth, openings, and service treatment
